label: Unrewarded, low-value a1 trial late in episode (D1/D2)
explanation: Never fires at GO or when the reward input is 1. It fires at D1 and D2 (about half the mass each) of trials whose D1 showed no reward (prev_reward==0 holds 93% of the mass), when the value head is low (value<7.13 holds 93% of the mass), and mostly on trials where the agent chooses a1 (82% of the mass); at D2 it prefers S2, i.e. rare a1 transitions. It is almost entirely confined to late-episode trials (99% of the mass at ep_trial>=50, rising sharply in trials 90-99), which is probably the low-value regime near the episode end. Top activations come from repeated unrewarded a1 trials, peaking at the D2 of an a1->S2 rare transition after a run of non-reward. action at D1 is the agent own upcoming choice (allowed; it is observed from D2). Adding ep_trial>=50 changes nothing. Recall and precision are both incomplete (dev F1 0.55); prev_reward==0 & D1/D2 alone gives mass recall 0.93 but precision 0.11. Magnitude grows with lower value and repeated non-reward; I did not check magnitude beyond that.
